text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm at the academy early one morning, still yawning to myself when I catch sight of Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Morning, Trainer. I'm the first one at school again!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A model student is always early to bed and early to rise. I got my beauty sleep last night, and now my skin is flawless!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, someone can't stop yawning. Did you stay up too late?
choice_data_list: I was working on our training program…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Then it's an early night for you tonight, you hear? I can't have you collapsing on me!
